fixes.what: Remove `<link rel="preload" href="assets/video/hero-poster-small.jpg" as="image">` from `<head>` when `prefers-reduced-motion` is not active or keep it low priority (`fetchpriority="low"`).
fixes.why: Preloading the video poster in `<head>` competes with the critical `tree-full.webp` LCP asset and the two web fonts on initial connection.

fixes.what: Remove permanent `will-change: transform` from `.tree__canopy`, `.tree__shake`, `.tree__sprig`, `.fruit-drop`, `.ground-art`, and `.fruit-roll` in `canopy.css`.
fixes.why: Promoting 7+ large masked layers (including the 1536x1260 canopy container) to permanent GPU textures consumes significant VRAM on mobile and mid-tier devices even when motion is paused or off-screen; GSAP handles layer promotion dynamically during active tweens.

fixes.what: Disconnect the `MutationObserver` or guard `sync()` so it does not re-trigger `ScrollTrigger.refresh()` redundantly right after `site.js` already calls `ScrollTrigger.refresh()` in `initMotion()`.
fixes.why: When `site.js` adds `html.motion`, both `site.js` and `canopy.js` call `ScrollTrigger.refresh()` in the same startup cycle, causing a double layout measurement pass on load.
